service.ar: إصدار شهادة ميلاد رقمية لمولود جديد

about: Request a digital birth certificate for a newborn, with optional attestation for use at home or abroad.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 50 to issue the certificate (English or Arabic)
AED 150 optional Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
